title: Rosalind and the Letter
author: Sebastian Oyelaran
blurb: Beatrix Eastwick, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
